basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old recent college graduate from Tipperary, Ireland. I'm currently working as a junior marketing assistant in a local firm. I love gaming, especially anything related to Xbox, and I'm always on the lookout for good deals. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new games, hiking around the beautiful Irish countryside, and indulging in a bit of photography. I usually browse Reddit late at night, around 11 PM to 2 AM. Currently single, I'm enjoying the freedom to focus on my career and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: While my degree was in marketing, I've always had a passion for technology and gaming. Most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching through online tutorials, forums, and staying up to date with tech news. I also learn a lot from fellow gamers and tech enthusiasts on Reddit.
